title: Validate an order request
code:
<flow name="validate-request">
  <http:listener config-ref="HTTP_Listener" path="/validate" allowedMethods="POST">
    <http:response statusCode="#[vars.httpStatus default 200]"/>
    <http:error-response statusCode="#[vars.httpStatus default 500]">
      <http:body>#[payload]</http:body>
    </http:error-response>
  </http:listener>
  <choice>
    <when expression="#[payload.orderId is String and
    payload.items is Array and
    (not isEmpty(payload.items)) and
    isEmpty(payload.items filter (item) -> not (item.qty is Number and item.qty > 0 and floor(item.qty) == item.qty))]">
      <ee:transform>
        <ee:message>
          <ee:set-payload><![CDATA[%dw 2.0
      output application/json
      ---
      {orderId: payload.orderId, valid: true}
      ]]></ee:set-payload>
        </ee:message>
      </ee:transform>
    </when>
    <otherwise>
      <set-variable variableName="httpStatus" value="#[400]"/>
      <ee:transform>
        <ee:message>
          <ee:set-payload><![CDATA[%dw 2.0
      output application/json
      ---
      {error: "INVALID_ORDER"}
      ]]></ee:set-payload>
        </ee:message>
      </ee:transform>
    </otherwise>
  </choice>
</flow>
